title: Chosen
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible story, 
God gives Saul a new heart
and Samuel tells Saul what signs to look for

SIGN 1: 
2 MEN who tell him that the donkeys are save

SIGN 2 : 
3 MEN with 3 GOATS | 3 LOVES OF BREAD | WINE

SIGN 3
A BAND of prohets: Carrying a flute, harp, lyre and a tambourine

ALL THESE SIGNS CAME TRUE!
THESE SIGNS WERE TO HELP SAUL UNDERSTAND 
THAT GOD HAD CHOSEN HIM TO BE THE KING

MAKE YOUR OWN TAMBOURINE
YOU WILL NEED
A paper plate
and crayons, pencils or kokis to decorate
and some bells
